Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam11 contributions

A Dream Wedding Come True at Smith's Kitchen and Bar
Jul 2024 • Friends
We hosted our intimate wedding ceremony here on July 14th and it was absolutely perfect! Despite being the restaurant's first wedding, their professionalism was outstanding. 

*SPACE
The restaurant's unique design and breathtaking bird's-eye view of District 1 are breathtaking. I love the way the restaurant used golden evening light, creating not only a cozy but also an unforgettable atmosphere for our guests. 

*FOOD
The food was a major highlight of the evening. Every dish was delicious and the portions were generous. Our guests raved about the flavors and presentation. It's clear that the restaurant takes pride in its culinary offerings.

*SERVICE
The staff was exceptional. They were professional, friendly, and went above and beyond to ensure our wedding day was perfect. Their attention to detail and willingness to accommodate our requests were truly appreciated. We felt incredibly well taken care of.

Overall
We cannot recommend this restaurant enough! If you're planning an event or simply looking for a memorable dining experience, this is the place to be.

We are incredibly grateful to Ms. Thuy Dan and the entire team for going out of their way to make us feel welcome and to help create a truly special wedding ceremony.
